guarantees.claim: sel_chk is continuously assigned the value of sel_o cast to mux2_sel_e type.
guarantees.cond: always (when generate block is active, i.e., Num==2)

assumptions.claim: sel_o must be driven to values 0 or 1 (valid mux2_sel_e enumeration) when Num==2.
assumptions.cond: when Num==2 and this assignment is active
assumptions.risk: If sel_o is driven to an out-of-range value (e.g., 2 or 3), sel_chk becomes an invalid enum member, which may cause downstream case or if-else to miss, potentially leading to undetected selection errors in AES buffer logic.

uncertain_points.claim: The comment labels this block as 'Checker' and casts sel_o to a mux2_sel_e enum type, but no actual checking (assertion, error flag, or value verification) is performed. The cast alone does not detect or reject illegal values of sel_o.
uncertain_points.risk: An invalid sel_o value (e.g., from a glitch, multi-bit error, or illegal FSM state) would be silently propagated into sel_chk, potentially selecting a wrong AES internal buffer and exposing key material or intermediate state.
